decision.summary: NO_ACTION: keep the remaining 78k REACH position after the earlier partial take-profit; no new management trigger or fresh daily edge is present.
decision.rationale: Active strategy is beecthor. Reconciliation is clean, daily_success_cooldown is inactive in the provided context, and the only open BTC price-hit position is the reduced will-bitcoin-reach-78k-on-may-20 Yes daily_thesis position. The key management fact is that the one allowed partial take-profit has already been executed today: the context records a 50% reduction at 0.82 around 15:16 UTC, leaving 0.9181 shares with about 0.5049 USD cost basis still open. At 18:00 UTC the remaining position is modestly profitable, but there is no new valid management trigger: the live executable sell price is only about 0.63 best bid, well below the 0.90-0.95 full take-profit zone, and the partial-take-profit rule has already been used. Re-adding is not justified either: only 6 hours remain, Binance short-term bias has cooled to neutral, and the latest Beecthor thesis is still stale and broadly bearish even if 78k was a mapped rebound zone. A second daily setup is also not clean: 79k REACH still needs an extra leg late in the session, while the dip side is too weakly priced and lacks a confirmed bearish breakdown. The correct action is to hold the remaining runner.
